verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury's core objects (FinancialAccount, OutboundPayment, ReceivedDebit, Transaction) are all API-driven, and the Dashboard is documented as just one access surface for the same underlying account data, indicating the API is the primary interface with the UI/mobile app layered on top rather than offering unique capabilities. missing for 10: an explicit statement of full UI/API parity and independent confirmation that no dashboard-only actions exist (e.g., embedded components are optional UI wrappers, not required for functionality).
